name: UPI Reserve Pay SBMD (Single Block Multi Debit)
flow: Customer Reserves Funds via UPI PIN authorisation (block)
Automatic debit exact amount from pre-approved limit
benefits: Transparent control in UPI apps, revocable
npci_quote: UPI was built to make digital payments simple, secure, universal, Agentic Payments takes vision into next era. With UPI Reserve Pay, users give consent once and allow intelligent systems to transact within controlled transparent way.
use_for_agentcart: Simulate SBMD: create reserve block -> store remaining/balance/expiry/consent_txn_id -> gate every debit total <= remaining, log audit, fallback to Payment Link if exceeds. Mirrors live limits for Buildathon bar.
